component.name: WhatsApp Desk
component.summary: GNOME desktop application for WhatsApp Web

description.p: WhatsApp Desk is a native GTK 4 wrapper for WhatsApp Web, built with GNOME integration in mind. It provides a dedicated desktop window with system tray support, desktop notifications, dark mode, and media download handling.

ul.li: System tray icon with context menu (Show / Hide / Quit)
Unread message badge on the tray icon

description.p: Fix: notification sounds no longer leave a phantom media player in the GNOME notification area, and media elements are properly cleaned up after playback ends.

ul.li: Notification sounds are now completely blocked (not just muted), preventing WebKitGTK from creating an MPRIS entry
Added ended/error event listeners on all audio and video elements to release the GStreamer pipeline and MPRIS entry immediately after playback finishes
Added MutationObserver to detect dynamically created media elements
Added ffmpeg-full extension to Flatpak manifest for H.264/AAC video codec support

description.p: Fix: implemented JS→Python bridge via window.webkit.messageHandlers for desktop notifications. WebKitGTK 6.0 does not emit the show-notification signal, so notifications are now forwarded directly from JavaScript to Python.

ul.li: Notifications are bridged from JavaScript to Python via WebKit UserContentManager message handlers, bypassing the non-functional show-notification signal
Removed dead code: tray.py (legacy AyatanaAppIndicator3, GTK3-only)

description.p: Fix: desktop notifications now work correctly. The Notification permission is patched directly on the original constructor instead of using a subclass that prevented WebKit from recognizing notification instances.

ul.li: Notification permission patching uses direct property redefinition instead of subclassing
Added Permissions API query interception for modern WhatsApp Web
Added DOCUMENT_END fallback for notification patch re-application
WhatsApp notification sounds are suppressed to prevent a phantom media player in GNOME Shell
Fixed desktop-entry hint for proper notification-to-app association
Added urgency and category hints for correct GNOME notification display
Added X-GNOME-UsesNotifications to the desktop entry file

description.p: Fix: upgrade release workflow — Node 24, reliable tag resolution, and CI best practices.
Chore: upgrade GitHub Actions to latest versions.
Fix: update CI to GNOME 50 runtime and add explicit tag_name to release action.
Fix: GNOME AppIndicator infinite loop on right click caused by double-wrapped DBusMenu variants.

Fix: the tray context menu now displays correctly. A type error in the DBusMenu GetLayout method (GLib.Variant slots receiving pre-built Variant objects) caused the menu to fail silently on first open.

New: right-clicking the system tray icon now shows a context menu with three options: Show (bring the window to the foreground), Hide (minimize to tray), and Quit (close the application). Implemented via the com.canonical.dbusmenu D-Bus protocol, compatible with GNOME Shell's AppIndicator extension.

Fix: document downloads (Word, Excel, PDF, etc.) now work correctly. Blob URLs generated by WhatsApp Web are no longer incorrectly routed to the system browser, which caused a "Launch cancelled" error.
